The IMF Technical Assistance Dataset records the IMF's technical assistance to member countries in {{< dataset-value period >}}: {{< dataset-value counts.missions >}} short-term missions and {{< dataset-value counts.advisors >}} resident advisor assignments in {{< dataset-value counts.countries >}} countries. It is compiled from IMF archival documents: annual technical assistance reports issued as Executive Board documents, and Secretary's Circulars listing staff assignments. For each mission, it records the country, purpose, IMF department, staff, dates, and source document. A country-year panel counts missions and mission-months, overall and by department. The dataset will be released once the working paper that introduces it is published.
